meta.title: {coach} — book a session, log every set
meta.description: One-to-one training with {coach}. See this week's open hours, book a session and keep every set in your own log.

hero.lede: I write the program, you log every set, and when the numbers stall we change the plan together.

pick.title: Pick a slot
pick.body: Every hatched block on the timetable is an hour I have free. Tap one and leave a note if you like.

confirm.title: I confirm
confirm.bodyApproval: Your request waits for my stamp, usually a few hours. Plans change: cancel {hours, plural, =0 {until the session starts} one {up to # hour before} other {up to # hours before}}.
confirm.bodyInstant: Your slot is confirmed the moment you book it. Plans change: cancel {hours, plural, =0 {until the session starts} one {up to # hour before} other {up to # hours before}}.

train.title: Train and log
train.body: After each set, tap in weight and reps. It all stays in your history, so next week you know which number to beat.

card.title: A card from the log
card.caption: This is what a training day looks like once you start logging. The names and numbers are samples.

hours.title: Hours and place
hours.empty: No fixed hours yet. The timetable above shows what is free.

footer.note: Only you and your coach see your sets.
